thread:
anya: Quick follow-up from design review — one more nit from compliance: the small 'Encrypted (KMS)' pill is ambiguous. Customers want to know provider (AWS/GCP/Azure) and alias without leaving the table. Screenshot attached. cc @dina @sam

sam: Totally. Options: 1) add a dedicated 'Key' column with full text (provider + alias) for the expanded table, 2) keep compact pill for compact mode but add a visible chevron to open details, and 3) enable a tiny copy-to-clipboard affordance for the alias. Thoughts?

dina: I like column for discoverability. For compact mode: pill -> tooltip/popup with provider + alias + "Copy alias" button. Proposed tooltip copy: "Customer-managed key (KMS) — provider: AWS, alias: /projects/prod/keys/foo..." but shorten with ellipsis and full value on hover or copy.

marcus: For exports: compliance teams asked for separate CSV columns: key_provider, key_alias, encryption_algorithm, rotation_date. Also they want human-friendly headers in the export modal. Suggest we ship both: machine headers (key_provider) + display headers ("Key provider") for 6 months. Also include an example line in the modal so auditors know format.

oliver: Accessibility: copy action must be focusable (role="button"), provide an aria-label like "Copy key alias for event 12345", and announce success with aria-live ("Alias copied"). Tooltips cannot be hover-only; keyboard focus must reveal them. For long aliases, ensure sr-only text with full alias is available to screen readers.

a11y-bot: Automated checks flagged two issues: pill contrast is <4.5:1 for small text, and the copy button currently has no visible focus ring. Recommend stronger contrast token and outline on focus. Also checklist: ensure tooltip content is reachable via keyboard and that dynamic export modal updates use role="status" for announcements.

sam: Implementation notes: backend already returns encryption.{provider, alias, alg, rotated_at} but alias sometimes null. UI should render 'Unknown key' when alias/provider missing and include a help link. For CSV we can add columns without breaking clients if we add them after existing headers; still file infra ticket for deprecation plan. I'll create PRODUCT-9001 for export headers + compatibility.

dina: Draft copy for tooltip & column: Column header: "Key (provider / alias)"; cell examples: "Customer-managed key (AWS) — alias: projects/prod/keys/foo" or "Redwood-managed". Tooltip short: "Customer-managed key (KMS) — provider: AWS. Press enter to copy alias or view details." I'll include truncated alias rendering and full alias in sr-only span.

marcus: One more UX ask: add a compact/expanded toggle on audit table (small switch). Expanded shows full Key column and rotation date; compact shows pill + chevron + copy. That helps teams that need dense rows.

oliver: Good idea. For keyboard users, when compact->popover opens, trap focus and Esc to close. When alias copied, we should programmatically set focus back to the copy button and announce status. Also add a 2s visual confirmation toast for sighted users.

a11y-bot: Add tests: axe snapshot for both compact/expanded, keyboard nav test that copies alias via Enter, and visual diff for focus states. File accessibility test ticket A11Y-672.

dina: I'll PR: add column copy, compact mode tooltip with copy button, human-readable export headers (behind compatibility), and a11y affordances. ETA: 3 business days for initial PR with mocks.

sam: Filing PRODUCT-9001 now and linking this thread. Will coordinate INFRA for CSV changes and deprecation timeline.

anya: Nice work. Outcomes: add 'Key' column for expanded view, compact pill + accessible tooltip + copy alias, CSV columns for provider/alias/alg/rotated_at with human headers & compatibility plan, compact/expanded toggle, and a11y/focus/live-region fixes. Dina to PR, Sam to file infra ticket, Oliver to add keyboard/a11y tests, Marcus to update export docs. Closing unless objections. :thumbsup:
